content:
I’ve been writing software since 2021, mostly backend systems for telecom, finance, and agriculture. I learned early to break a problem down and picture every step before writing code, and it still shapes how I work.

My sweet spot is the unglamorous stuff: SQL performance, clean APIs, security, and system integration. A favorite win: growing bulk inserts from about 10,000 to 140,000 rows per batch by passing XML lists straight into SQL Server stored procedures.

I mostly work in .NET with SQL Server and Postgres, pick up React when a feature needs it, and lately build with Claude Code. Off the keyboard: pull-ups, badminton, swimming, and black coffee.

Open to freelance projects and backend roles. Got a messy problem? Let’s talk.
